lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Maestro,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: is it true that karaoke is popular?
Actually, it has always been popular.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Is it really that fun?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: You're in a cramped room and have to share a microphone with everyone.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I've also heard that some people dance on the sofa.
Sounds like you already have a good picture of what it's like.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Noise and Volume filled me in.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Volume goes to one whenever she hasn't had enough even after a live concert.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Sometimes, she even goes on her own.
It can be a lot of fun even when you're on your own.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I thought it was something you'd do with a big group of friends.
Not necessarily. Everyone has different ways of enjoying it.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I heard there are different types of karaoke as well.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: If you know any, could you recommend me one?
Coin-operated karaoke, for the budget-conscious.
A karaoke pub, for those who want to sing at the table.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Wow, I didn't realize such a thing existed.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: I might be able to use it for practice.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: But you sure know a lot more about karaoke

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: than I imagined.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Do you go there often?
Hardly.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Then, how are you so well-informed?
Because I'm always getting roped into it.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: By who?
Someone who lives by the train station.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: In that case,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: if you go as often as you do,

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: you and this mystery person must both be capable singers.
Far from it. Neither of us can carry a tune to save our lives.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Oh, really?
You don't have to be good at something to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: Take me with you next time

lines.speaker: aria
lines.text: and I'll give you some pointers on how to improve your singing.
Sure, I'll let Diesel know.
